output.reason: The linked PR [ev-c06102df5e49] names the subject: it adds a `headers` option to the HTTP provider, which defines custom headers sent in the configuration fetch request. The changed files [ev-ceff2cb28b7f] show that this option is in the static configuration (CLI, env, TOML and YAML references, plus pkg/provider/http). The change is an added optional static-config key of the HTTP provider. Exposure is limited to environments that use the HTTP provider, and since the option is optional and nothing else changes [ev-a4518986637f, ev-c06102df5e49], an operator who does nothing sees no effect.
